items.title: Section: Hearing and Reflecting on the True Teaching Opens

items.zh: 云何名為聞思正法？謂正法者，若佛世尊、若佛弟子、正士、正至、正善丈夫，宣說開顯分別照了。此復云何？所謂契經、應頌、記別，廣說如前十二分教。是名正法。云何契經？謂薄伽梵，於彼彼方所，為彼彼所化有情，依彼彼所化諸行差別，宣說無量蘊相應語、處相應語、緣起相應語、食相應語、諦相應語、界相應語、聲聞乘相應語、獨覺乘相應語、如來乘相應語、念住正斷神足根力覺支道支等相應語、不淨息念諸學證淨等相應語。結集如來正法藏者，攝聚如是種種聖語，為令聖教久住世故。以諸美妙名句文身，如其所應次第安布、次第結集。謂能貫穿縫綴種種能引義利、能引梵行真善妙義。
items.en: What is meant by hearing and reflecting on the true teaching? The true teaching is what is proclaimed, revealed, analysed, and clarified by the Blessed One, by the Buddha's disciples, by upright persons, by those who have reached correctness, and by genuinely good persons. What, further, is this teaching? Namely, discourses, verse restatements, prophecies, and so on through the twelve divisions of scripture explained before. This is called the true teaching. … What are discourses? It means that the Blessed One, in various places, for various beings to be taught, according to the various differences in their conduct, proclaimed countless forms of teaching connected with the aggregates, connected with the sense-fields, connected with dependent origination, connected with nutriment, connected with the truths, connected with the elements, connected with the hearer-disciple vehicle, connected with the solitary-realiser vehicle, connected with the vehicle of the Tathāgata, connected with the foundations of mindfulness, right exertions, bases of miraculous power, faculties, powers, factors of awakening, and path-factors, and connected with the training in impurity, mindfulness of breathing, and the confirmed faiths. Those who compiled the treasury of the Tathāgata's true teaching gathered together these various holy sayings and, so that the sacred teaching might long abide in the world, arranged them in proper sequence with excellent words, phrases, and letters, compiling them in due order — that is, stringing and stitching together their various meanings, capable of bringing benefit, capable of supporting pure conduct, genuinely good and subtle.

items.title: Three More Divisions: Verse Restatements, Prophecies, and Standalone Verses

items.zh: 云何應頌？謂於中間、或於最後宣說伽他，或復宣說未了義經。是名應頌。云何記別？謂於是中，記別弟子命過已後當生等事，或復宣說已了義經。是名記別。云何諷頌？謂非直說，是結句說。或作二句、或作三句、或作四句、或作五句、或作六句等。是名諷頌。
items.en: What are verse restatements? They are verses spoken in the middle or at the end of a teaching, or verses that further express a teaching not yet fully drawn out. This is called a verse restatement. What are prophecies? They are declarations of where a disciple will be reborn after death, or the concise restatement of a teaching already fully explained. This is called a prophecy. What are standalone verses? They are not spoken as prose, but composed in verse — in couplets, triplets, quatrains, or stanzas of five or six lines and more. This is called a standalone verse.

items.title: Unprompted Teachings and the Opening of Circumstance-Based Teachings

items.zh: 云何自說？謂於是中，不顯能請補特伽羅名字、種姓，為令當來正法久住、聖教久住，不請而說。是名自說。云何因緣？謂於是中，顯示能請補特伽羅名字、種姓，因請而說；及諸所有毘奈耶相應，有因有緣別解脫經。
items.en: What are unprompted teachings? They are teachings in which the name and lineage of the one who requested them is not given, spoken without being requested at all, so that the true teaching and the sacred doctrine might long endure. This is called an unprompted teaching. What are circumstance-based teachings? They are teachings in which the name and lineage of the one who requested them is given, spoken in response to that request; and they also include all the discipline-related teachings, the rules of individual liberation, each arising from some specific cause and circumstance.

items.title: Three Narrative Divisions: Parables, Past Lives of Disciples, and the Buddha's Own Past Lives

items.zh: 云何譬喻？謂於是中，有譬喻說。由譬喻故，本義明淨。是名譬喻。云何本事？謂諸所有宿世相應事義言教。是名本事。云何本生？謂於是中，宣說世尊在過去世彼彼方分，若死、若生，行菩薩行、行難行行。是名本生。
items.en: What are parables? They are teachings that include a comparison, through which the original meaning becomes clear and vivid. This is called a parable. What are accounts of past lives? They are teachings concerning matters connected with the past lives of the Buddha's disciples. This is called an account of past lives. What are birth stories? They are teachings that tell of the Blessed One, in various places in past lives, dying and being reborn, practising the bodhisattva path, undertaking difficult practices. This is called a birth story.

items.zh: 云何方廣？謂於是中，廣說一切諸菩薩道，為令修證阿耨多羅三藐三菩提、十力、無畏、無障智等一切功德。是名方廣。云何希法？謂於是中，宣說諸佛、諸佛弟子、比丘比丘尼、式叉摩那、勞策男、勞策女、近事男、近事女等，若共不共，勝於其餘、勝諸世間，同意所許，甚奇希有最勝功德。
items.en: What are extended teachings? They are teachings that set forth the entire bodhisattva path, so that one may cultivate and realise unsurpassed complete awakening, the ten powers, the fearlessnesses, unobstructed knowledge, and every other such quality. This is called an extended teaching. What are marvels? They are teachings that set forth the Buddhas, and the Buddha's disciples — monks, nuns, female probationers, novices of both genders, and laymen and laywomen — describing qualities, whether shared with or unique among the world, surpassing all others, surpassing the world entirely, universally acknowledged as truly extraordinary, rare, and supreme.

items.title: Section: The Twelfth Division Closes the Whole Framework — Analytical Treatises and the Three Baskets

items.zh: 云何論議？所謂一切摩呾履迦、阿毘達磨，研究甚深素呾纜義，宣暢一切契經宗要。是名論議。如是所說十二分教，三藏所攝。謂或有素怛纜藏攝，或有毘奈耶藏攝，或有阿毘達磨藏攝。當知此中，若說契經、應頌、記別、諷頌、自說、譬喻、本事、本生、方廣、希法，是名素怛纜藏。若說因緣，是名毘奈耶藏。若說論議，是名阿毘達磨藏。是故如是十二分教，三藏所攝。如是一切，正士、正至、正善丈夫共所宣說，故名正法。
items.en: What are analytical treatises? They are all the foundational analyses and further teachings that investigate the profound meaning of the discourses, fully expounding the essential themes of all scripture. This is called analytical treatise. … Know that, among these, discourses, verse restatements, prophecies, standalone verses, unprompted teachings, parables, accounts of past lives, birth stories, extended teachings, and marvels are comprised in the Basket of Discourses. Circumstance-based teachings are comprised in the Basket of Discipline. Analytical treatises are comprised in the Basket of Further Teaching. Thus these twelve divisions are comprised within the three baskets. All of this, proclaimed together by upright persons, those who have reached correctness, and genuinely good persons, is called the true teaching.

items.title: Section: Hearing the True Teaching — Seven Kinds of Scholarship, Text and Meaning

items.zh: 聽聞此故，名聞正法。此復云何？謂如有一，或受持素呾纜，或受持毘奈耶，或受持阿毘達磨，或受持素怛纜及毘奈耶，或受持素怛纜及阿毘達磨，或受持毘奈耶及阿毘達磨，或具受持素怛纜、毘奈耶、阿毘達磨。如是一切，名聞正法。此聞正法復有二種。一、聞其文，二、聞其義。
items.en: Hearing this is called hearing the true teaching. What, further, does this mean? It means that a person may uphold the discourses alone, or the discipline alone, or the further teaching alone; or the discourses together with the discipline; or the discourses together with the further teaching; or the discipline together with the further teaching; or all three — discourses, discipline, and further teaching — together. All of this is called hearing the true teaching. This hearing of the true teaching is, moreover, of two kinds: hearing its words, and hearing its meaning.

blocks.text: What counts as the true teaching, and its twelve divisions. These terms appear throughout Buddhist literature; it is worth knowing them.

"What is proclaimed, revealed, analysed, and clarified by the Blessed One, by the Buddha's disciples, by upright persons, by those who have reached correctness." Master Cháng Bǎi on 契經: 契 means fitting both the principle of the Buddhas above and the capacities of beings below; 經 means Dharma and constancy.

items: **Verse restatements** (geya): verses in the middle or at the end of a teaching.
**Prophecies** (vyākaraṇa): declarations of where someone will be reborn or attain.
**Circumstance-based teachings** (nidāna): rules prompted by an occasion.
**Parables** (avadāna): "teachings that include a comparison, through which the original meaning becomes clear".
**Birth stories** (jātaka): the Buddha's own past lives.

blocks.text: Circumstance-based teachings belong to the Vinaya; analytical treatises to the Abhidharma; the rest to the Sūtra basket. Master Cháng Bǎi pairs the three baskets with the three trainings: Vinaya with discipline, sūtras with concentration, Abhidharma with wisdom.
Some uphold one basket, some two, some all three. Hearing is "of two kinds: hearing its words, and hearing its meaning". Master Cháng Bǎi: hearing only the words is not enough.

quiz.q: According to the treatise, who proclaims the true teaching?
options: the Buddha, his disciples, upright persons, those who have reached correctness, and genuinely good persons
quiz.why: "The true teaching is what is proclaimed, revealed, analysed, and clarified by the Blessed One, by the Buddha's disciples, by upright persons, by those who have reached correctness, and by genuinely good persons." Venerable Miào Jìng: what is taught to you as they themselves realised it — that is the true teaching.

quiz.q: What does each master stress about the 契 in 契經?
options: Cháng Bǎi: fitting the Buddhas' principle above and beings' capacities below; Miào Jìng: chiefly according with the many teachings, not merely fitting capacities
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: 契 means fitting the principle of the Buddhas above and the capacities of beings below; 經 means Dharma and constancy. Venerable Miào Jìng: 契 means according — speech that accords with this great body of teaching.

quiz.q: Verse restatements speak of "teachings not yet drawn out" and prophecies of "teachings already drawn out." What does Venerable Miào Jìng say 了義 means here?
options: unclear is "not yet drawn out," clear is "drawn out" — not the usual sense of definitive
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: what is not said clearly is "not drawn out"; what is made clear is "drawn out." The English "concise restatement" matches Cháng Bǎi's first reading but runs opposite to the commentary's "detailed analysis of what was briefly stated."

quiz.q: According to Master Cháng Bǎi, which is the most famous unprompted teaching?
quiz.why: Teachings in which the requester's name is not given, spoken without request. Master Cháng Bǎi: what the Buddha speaks unasked is called unprompted; the most famous is the Amitābha Sutra.

quiz.q: What does the treatise say parables accomplish?
options: through the comparison the original meaning becomes clear and vivid
quiz.why: "Teachings that include a comparison, through which the original meaning becomes clear and vivid." Venerable Miào Jìng: it becomes easier to understand and clearer, with no doubt remaining.

quiz.q: How are the twelve divisions sorted into the three baskets, and where do circumstance-based teachings go?
options: ten go to discourses; circumstance-based to discipline; analytical treatises to further teaching
quiz.why: "Circumstance-based teachings are comprised in the Basket of Discipline. Analytical treatises are comprised in the Basket of Further Teaching." Master Cháng Bǎi: ten divisions belong to the discourses, circumstance-based teachings to the Vinaya, analytical treatises to the Abhidharma.

quiz.q: What are the two kinds of hearing the true teaching, and what fault does Master Cháng Bǎi see in neglecting either?
options: hearing words and hearing meaning; words alone may distort meaning, meaning alone may lack the words
quiz.why: "This hearing of the true teaching is, moreover, of two kinds: hearing its words, and hearing its meaning." Master Cháng Bǎi: hearing only the words may distort the meaning by clinging to the letter; hearing only the meaning may leave one lacking the words.
